items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: in the next column is a picture of Lee Morgan. And the headline was “Lee Morgan skudt i New York.”

ctx.x: I see. That does sound like him. Well so how did you land with Maynard Ferguson?

I was playing at a club called Montmartre in Copenhagen and this English trumpet player came in and asked if he could sit in. And it turned out he was Maynard’s lead trumpet player. And he was on vacation in Copenhagen and he said, “you know Maynard’s going to be looking for a baritone player soon because the baritone player doesn’t want to tour anymore. So he said if you’re interested I’ll give Maynard your info. So this was in the day when people sent telegrams. So I got a telegram from Maynard saying Al Downey…
God. Do you still have that?
